voice.summary: Glimmerdeck sounds like a trading card flavour text: short, mythic and a little grand. It describes each card by rarity, power and a single striking image.
dos: Write card text as one vivid, mythic sentence
Show rarity and power in plain labels

taglines: Forged where the lights touch the sea
Hold the glare, keep the glow
boilerplate: Glimmerdeck is a collectible card brand whose holographic cards tilt and shimmer with the viewer's movement, each one carrying a rarity, a power and a short legend.
